question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**top**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is determining which food or drink has the highest antioxidant power, leading to a ranking where the "**top**" refers to the highest position.
 
• The word "**top**" is fitting as it denotes the highest rank or position in the comparison.
 
• "Below," "bottom," and "lowest" would incorrectly suggest a lower ranking.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *(1) Numerous health benefits, including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer, have been (2) attributed to antioxidants; however, according to dietitian Vinson, these benefits depend on how well antioxidants are absorbed and (3) utilised by the body. According to the study, coffee has more antioxidant power than other well-known foods and drinks, like tea, milk, chocolate, and cranberries. Dates had the highest antioxidants per serving out of all the foods and drinks (4) analysed, but because dates are not consumed to the same extent as coffee, the latter comes out on (5) top__, according to Vinson.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Below**: Indicates a lower position, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• **Bottom**: Refers to the lowest position, not applicable here.
 
• **Lowest**: Again suggests the least in rank, which does not fit.
